page_text_ocr_zh:
中国民间故事绘本系列
老鼠嫁女
李雪/改编
杨希/绘
page_text_en:
Chinese Folk Tales Picture Book Series
The Mouse Marries Off Her Daughter
Adapted by Li Xue
Illustrated by Yang Xi
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《老鼠嫁女》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息以及一只穿着喜庆嫁衣的老鼠新娘和两只捧着嫁妆的老鼠，画面充满婚礼的喜庆氛围。

page_text_ocr_zh: “一月一，年初一，一月二，年初二。年初三，早上床，今夜老鼠娶新娘。”每年的大年初三，大人总会招呼孩子早早上床休息。因为这天晚上，老鼠的女儿要出嫁啦。老鼠嫁女儿，这可真新鲜！新郎是谁呢？
page_text_en: "January 1st, New Year's Day; January 2nd, the second day of the New Year. On the third day, get to bed early, tonight the mice will marry their bride." Every year on the third day of the Lunar New Year, adults always tell children to go to bed early. Because on this night, the mouse's daughter is getting married. The mice marrying off their daughter—how fresh! Who is the groom?
summary_zh: 本页描绘了老鼠女儿出嫁前的场景，画面中老鼠新娘穿着喜庆的嫁衣，周围有老鼠们捧着嫁妆，文字介绍了大年初三老鼠娶新娘的习俗，并引出对新郎身份的疑问。

page_text_ocr_zh:
很久很久以前，在一家农户的墙角里，生活着一对老鼠夫妇。
他们生了一个又漂亮又乖巧的女儿。眼看鼠姑娘一天天大了，爸爸
妈妈却一天天发愁。
俗话说，“女大不中留”，得给鼠姑娘选一个好女婿！
page_text_en:
Long, long ago, in the corner of a farmer's house, lived a pair of mouse parents.
They had a beautiful and obedient daughter. As the mouse girl grew up day by day, her father and mother grew more and more worried.
As the saying goes, 'When a daughter grows up, she can't be kept at home,' so they must find a good husband for the mouse girl!
summary_zh: 本页讲述了很久以前，一对老鼠夫妇生下了一个漂亮乖巧的女儿，随着女儿长大，父母开始为她挑选女婿而发愁。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“宝贝女儿，你要什么样的女婿啊？”鼠妈妈悄悄地问自己的孩子。
鼠姑娘脸红了。她垂着头，用蚊子一样的声音说：“我不要金也不要银，就希望能嫁给世界上最伟大的——”
page_text_en:
"Dear daughter, what kind of husband do you want?" the mouse mother asked her child quietly.
The mouse girl blushed. She lowered her head and said in a voice like a mosquito: "I don't want gold or silver, I just hope to marry the greatest in the world—"
summary_zh: 鼠妈妈询问女儿想要什么样的女婿，女儿害羞地表示希望嫁给世界上最伟大的人。

page_text_ocr_zh:
谁才是世界上最伟大的女婿呢？鼠爸爸想了一夜，就连长长的老鼠胡须都被捻断了好几根。
第二天中午，太阳炙烤着大地，所有的生物都恨不得能躲起来。鼠爸爸一拍大腿叫起来：“我知道了，我知道了，太阳当然是最伟大的啊！太阳再合适不过啦。”
page_text_en:
Who could be the greatest groom in the world? The mouse father thought about it all night, and even broke several of his long mouse whiskers.
At noon the next day, the sun was scorching the earth, and all creatures wished they could hide. The mouse father slapped his thigh and shouted, "I know, I know! The sun is surely the greatest! The sun is perfect!"
summary_zh: 鼠爸爸为女儿寻找最伟大的女婿而苦思冥想，最终在太阳炙烤大地时，认为太阳是最伟大的人选。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“太阳先生，你是这世界上最伟大的，我想把女儿嫁给你。”鼠爸爸从老鼠洞里钻出来，抹了抹额头上的汗珠，朝着天上的太阳大声说。

太阳看了看鼠爸爸，喷出一口热气：“谢谢你。但我不是这世界上最伟大的，如果天空有云，大家就看不见我。云比我厉害啊。”
page_text_en:
"Mr. Sun, you are the greatest in the world. I want to marry my daughter to you." The mouse father poked his head out of the mouse hole, wiped the sweat from his forehead, and shouted up at the sun in the sky.

The sun looked at the mouse father and puffed out a hot breath: "Thank you. But I am not the greatest in the world. If there are clouds in the sky, everyone can't see me. Clouds are more powerful than I am."
summary_zh: 鼠爸爸向太阳提出要将女儿嫁给他，太阳谦虚地表示自己并非最伟大的，因为云能遮住他，认为云比自己更厉害。

page_text_ocr_zh:
正说着，一朵云彩飘过来，遮住了太阳。鼠爸爸把前爪在嘴边合拢，扯着嗓子喊起来：“云啊云，世界上最伟大的云，我想把女儿嫁给你！”
“我可不是啊，只要风一来——”
page_text_en:
Just then, a cloud floated over and covered the sun. The mouse father cupped his front paws by his mouth and shouted, "Cloud, cloud, the greatest cloud in the world, I want to marry my daughter to you!"
"I'm not the greatest, though—whenever the wind comes—"
summary_zh: 鼠爸爸看到云遮住了太阳，便向云提出要将女儿嫁给他，但云谦虚地表示自己并非最伟大的，因为风能吹动它。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“风！伟大的风先生，我把女儿嫁给你好不好？”
听到鼠爸爸的请求，风可不同意。他说：“世界上还有比我更了不起的呢！一堵墙就能把我挡住，哎哟！”
云的话音刚落，呼——风来了！
风把云吹成一块块的，又在云中间穿来穿去，和他们在空中捉迷藏。
page_text_en:
"Wind! Great Mr. Wind, would you like to marry my daughter?"
Hearing the mouse father's request, the wind disagreed. He said, "There's still someone greater than me in the world! A wall can block me, oh dear!"
The moment the cloud finished speaking, whoosh—here comes the wind!
The wind blew the cloud into pieces, then darted in and out among the clouds, playing hide-and-seek with them in the sky.
summary_zh: 鼠爸爸向风提出将女儿嫁给他，但风拒绝了，认为墙能挡住他，因此不是最伟大的。随后风出现，吹散云朵，并与云在空中玩捉迷藏。

page_text_ocr_zh:
风撞在农户家的墙上，瞬间就消失不见了。
鼠爸爸好奇地走过来，他从来没有这样仔细打量过墙。墙又高又大，看上去谁也不能越过他。
“墙啊墙，您……是最伟大的吗？”
鼠爸爸小心地问。
“我？应该是吧……”
page_text_en:
The wind bumped into the wall of a farmer's house and vanished instantly.
Mr. Mouse curiously walked over. He had never examined a wall so carefully before. The wall was tall and big, and looked like no one could ever get over it.
"Wall, wall, are you... the greatest?" Mr. Mouse asked cautiously.
"Me? I suppose so..."
summary_zh: 风被墙挡住后消失，鼠爸爸走近观察高大的墙，并好奇地询问墙是否是最伟大的，墙谦虚地表示自己应该是最伟大的。

page_text_ocr_zh:
吱吱！鼠爸爸的话没说完，一只小老鼠从墙边的小洞里钻了出来。鼠爸爸认识他！他就是隔壁邻居家的鼠小伙儿。前些日子，他在墙边又掏土又啃稻草，真是没少下工夫。
鼠小伙儿长大了，也到了娶妻子的时候了。
墙看起来很稳重，真是当女婿的合适人选呀。
“墙，我想把女儿——”
page_text_en:
Squeak! Before the mouse father could finish speaking, a little mouse popped out of a small hole by the wall. The mouse father knew him! He was the mouse boy from the neighboring household. Recently, he had been digging and gnawing rice straw by the wall—truly putting in a lot of effort.
The mouse boy had grown up and it was time for him to marry.
The wall looked very steady—perfect for a son-in-law.
"Wall, I want to give my daughter—"
summary_zh: 鼠爸爸正想把女儿嫁给墙，一只隔壁邻居的小老鼠从墙洞里钻了出来，原来他就是那个一直在墙边挖洞的鼠小伙儿，也到了娶妻的年纪。

page_text_ocr_zh:
墙追问道：“您找我有什么事儿吗？”
鼠爸爸盯着鼠小伙儿，把话咽了回去。
他想：墙还吹牛说自己是最伟大的。可是小小的老鼠，竟然能把他打个洞！所以，我们才是最伟大的！
page_text_en:
The wall asked, “Is there something you need?”
The mouse father stared at the young mouse and swallowed his words.
He thought: The wall is still boasting that it’s the greatest. But a tiny mouse can actually dig a hole through it! So, we are the greatest!
summary_zh: 鼠爸爸正想把女儿嫁给墙，却看到一只小老鼠从墙洞里钻出，他意识到连墙都能被老鼠打洞，于是认为老鼠才是最伟大的。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“亲爱的鼠小伙儿，你愿意成为我的女婿吗？”鼠爸爸拉住鼠小伙儿。
“我愿意啊，很愿意！”鼠小伙儿大声说。能娶到鼠姑娘，他可真是太高兴了。
鼠爸爸急忙跑回家，把这个好消息告诉鼠妈妈。
鼠妈妈表示反对：“不行，不行！谁不知道我们老鼠怕猫呀？老头子呀！你准是让太阳给晒糊涂了！猫才应该是最厉害的吧？”
“你说的很有道理！那么，我就去找大花猫问一问吧。”
page_text_en:
"Dear young mouse, would you like to be my son-in-law?" the mouse father grabbed the young mouse.
"I would, I really would!" the young mouse shouted happily. To marry the mouse girl, he was overjoyed.
The mouse father hurried home to share this good news with the mouse mother.
The mouse mother objected: "No, no! Who doesn't know that mice are afraid of cats? Old man! You must have been sun-struck! Cats should be the most powerful, right?"
"You're absolutely right! Then, I'll go ask the big flower cat."
summary_zh: 鼠爸爸想把女儿嫁给鼠小伙儿，鼠妈妈反对，认为猫才是最厉害的，鼠爸爸决定去找大花猫询问。

page_text_ocr_zh:
墙角边的大花猫刚刚吃完一条鱼，伸了伸懒腰，正准备美美地睡一觉呢！忽然，他觉得自己的胡须被谁拽了一下。
“大——花——猫！你愿意娶我的女儿做新娘吗？”
大花猫打了个饱嗝儿。
现在肚子里饱饱的，连一根老鼠尾巴都吃不下。不过，要是明天饿了也说不定。
page_text_en:
The big spotted cat by the corner had just finished a fish, stretched lazily, and was about to take a nice nap! Suddenly, he felt his whiskers being pulled.
"Big—Spotted—Cat! Would you like to marry my daughter as your bride?"
The big spotted cat let out a big burp.
Now his stomach is full, he can't even eat a single mouse tail. But if he's hungry tomorrow, who knows?
summary_zh: 鼠爸爸找到大花猫，想把女儿嫁给他，但大花猫刚吃完鱼，打了个饱嗝，表示现在太饱，暂时不想吃老鼠，不过明天饿了也许会考虑。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“喵喵！好哇！太愿意了！从今天开始，所有的老鼠都是我亲戚！”
大花猫一口答应了这门婚事。大年初三这天，鼠姑娘就要出嫁啦。
鼠姑娘要嫁给大花猫！这个消息让十里八乡的老鼠都轰动了。
他们送来了各式各样的礼物，有一捧发霉的花生、吃剩下的半根火腿肠，还有一颗啃成心形的大馒头……
鼠爸爸得意地说：“这可是鼠族头等大事。老鼠和世界上最伟大的猫结为亲家，以后谁也不能欺负我们了！”
page_text_en:
"Meow! Great! I'm so willing! From today on, all mice are my relatives!"
The big spotted cat agreed to the marriage immediately. On the third day of the Lunar New Year, the mouse girl would be getting married.
The mouse girl was going to marry the big spotted cat! This news stirred up all the mice in the surrounding areas.
They brought all kinds of gifts: a handful of moldy peanuts, half a leftover ham sausage, and a big steamed bun bitten into the shape of a heart...
The mouse father proudly said, "This is the most important event in the mouse clan. Mice and the greatest cat in the world are becoming in-laws. From now on, no one can bully us!"
summary_zh: 大花猫答应了鼠爸爸的婚事，鼠姑娘将嫁给大花猫，消息传开后，十里八乡的老鼠纷纷前来送礼，鼠爸爸对此感到非常得意。

page_text_ocr_zh:
大年初三，就是鼠姑娘嫁人的大日子！
敲敲打打打打敲敲，鼠姑娘坐在花轿上，
四只身强力壮的老鼠扛起花轿。两只小老鼠在
前面走，后面还有捧着、扛着、拽着各种嫁妆
的老鼠。这条长长的送嫁的队伍走啊走啊，一
直走进大花猫的家。

“恭喜恭喜！”“猫新郎一表人才，
是世界上最伟大的！”
老鼠亲戚们还想夸夸鼠姑娘，这时大
花猫不耐烦地叫了一声：“喵呜！”
老鼠们吓得撒腿就跑，只剩下一顶孤
零零的花轿和数不清的好吃的。
page_text_en:
The third day of the Lunar New Year is the big day for the mouse girl's wedding!
Bang bang, ding ding, bang bang, the mouse girl sits in the bridal sedan chair,
four strong mice carry the sedan chair. Two little mice walk in front,
while behind them, other mice carry, hold, and drag various wedding gifts.
This long wedding procession walks and walks, all the way into the big tabby cat's home.

"Congratulations! Congratulations!" "The cat groom is handsome and talented,
the greatest in the world!"
The mouse relatives still wanted to praise the mouse girl, but at that moment,
the big tabby cat impatiently called out: "Meow!"
The mice were scared and ran away, leaving only a lonely sedan chair
and countless delicious foods.
summary_zh: 鼠姑娘在大年初三出嫁，由老鼠们抬着花轿前往大花猫家，婚礼队伍热闹非凡。当老鼠亲戚们准备夸赞鼠姑娘时，大花猫一声“喵呜”吓跑了所有老鼠，只留下空花轿和食物。

page_text_ocr_zh:
第二天，鼠爸爸和鼠妈妈来看女儿。
咦，女儿不见啦！
鼠妈妈叫起来：“女儿在哪里？我的女儿在哪里？”
大花猫腆着肚子走过来，说：“喵呜！
爸爸妈妈，我怕别人欺负她，把她藏在我的
肚子里了。你们也进来看看呀？”
大花猫露出嗓子眼——鼠妈妈和鼠爸爸
会不会接受他的邀请呢？你猜猜！
page_text_en:
The next day, Mr. Mouse and Mrs. Mouse came to visit their daughter.
Hmm, where is the daughter?
Mrs. Mouse cried out: "Where is my daughter? Where is my daughter?"
The big tabby cat, puffing out his belly, said: "Meow! 
Dad and Mom, I'm afraid someone might bully her, so I've hidden her inside my belly. You should come in and take a look too!"
The big tabby cat showed his throat—would Mrs. Mouse and Mr. Mouse accept his invitation? Guess!
summary_zh: 鼠爸爸和鼠妈妈来看女儿，却发现女儿不见了。大花猫声称已将女儿藏在自己肚子里，并邀请他们进去看，画面暗示了女儿的危险处境。
